correctness.rationale: For girth>=6, each distance-two pair has a unique midpoint; every Rips simplex outside the union of closed-neighborhood simplices is a maximal alternating triangle of a simple hexagon, because any fourth vertex would force a different 6-cycle sharing a graph edge. The neighborhood union collapses to G, two triangles per hexagon attach along the same loop, and canceling one attached disk with its private graph edge leaves b−t graph loops and t freely attached 2-spheres. h=0 case reduces to girth>=7 collapse. Independently enumerated the theta(3,3,4) graph (9 vertices,10 edges), found exactly its two exceptional triangles and expected (9,23,17,2) face vector.
risks: Finite theta verification is a boundary check, not the all-graph proof; graph assumptions are essential and exclude intersecting hexagons along edges.
